description: This file contains definitions and function declarations for parsing nl80211 netlink messages related to Wi-Fi interface, channel, wiphy, station, scan results, and radar events. It specifically includes functions to parse various nlmsg attributes into corresponding data structures, with a focus on Wi-Fi subsystem information.
